svg.aria-label: Transcript RAG retrieval structure: a question is optionally rewritten by HyDE or multi-query, retrieved in parallel by MiniLM semantic search and BM25 at thirty candidates each, fused by reciprocal rank, reranked by a local cross-encoder down to top-k, and answered by one of four paths — single-hop, recursive multi-hop, a LangGraph ReAct agent, or a GraphRAG router over Neo4j — with every configuration scored on recall@k, MRR, NDCG and a RAGAS or depth-v2 judge.
svg.text: graded on recall@k · MRR · NDCG@10 · RAGAS + depth-v2 judge

g.title: the question a visitor asks of the 102-video corpus
optional query-side transforms — HyDE writes the passage that would answer, multi-query fans out paraphrases; both cached per question so a sweep is free to repeat
dense retrieval — MiniLM embeddings in ChromaDB, 30 candidates; a parallel contextualised collection is the index-side variant
BM25 keyword retrieval, 30 candidates — recovers the exact figures, scheme names and dates that embeddings blur
reciprocal-rank fusion (k=60) of the two rankings — the best config in the ablation on recall@10, MRR and NDCG@10
local cross-encoder rerank to top-k — measured to help a bi-encoder ranking and hurt a fused one
four answer paths over the same retrieval — single-hop, recursive multi-hop, a LangGraph ReAct agent and a GraphRAG router over Neo4j — all returning timestamped citations
